limitations: This changes supervision, not the number of independent contexts.
Same-author visible-text rechecking is not independent external review.
Step gold answers are labels only; branches do not see each other or each other's gold answers. There is no explicit consistency loss.
Mean per-question loss makes original questions retain between half and three-quarters of each changed record's unaugmented CE share; augmentation must be audited before launch.
Additional question RNG draws can change none-pair augmentation; original augmentation code remains unchanged.
No effect measured; official diagnostic tests have already informed design.
At original stage3, adding step branches changes one near-tied Qwen3.5 development primary top choice; max probability difference 0.000606. Official evaluation retains original question layouts.

evaluation_plan.before: Original dev488/probe185 identical to original-stage3 v7 baselines; step dev732 before/after.
evaluation_plan.after: Original development and probe, step development, all original 1500 training contexts/2320 primary questions, full hard-v1 and devtools-v1.
evaluation_plan.success: Both models must clearly improve all seven real categories; step or training accuracy alone is insufficient.
